narr: A nearly stationary corridor of thunderstorms developed from central Kentucky to northwest Tennessee, including Christian and Todd Counties. These storms resulted in excessive rainfall amounts over places that received heavy rain during the early morning severe storms. The storms occurred in a narrow axis of instability along a southeastward moving cold front.
ev: Vehicles were stalled out in downtown Hopkinsville, as shown in a photo posted on social media.
There were multiple reports of flash flooding on many state and county roads, including some main roads.
